cbb.candidate_availability_calendar.measurement_fix: Per candidate c and as-of t: D_free(c) = days from t until the candidate's current team is eliminated (expected value and pmf from cbb.bracket_sim, 0 if season over; NBA assistants use playoff elimination) plus days to the next buyout step-down date that reduces the buyout below the school's reported budget (cbb.program_hiring_resources; infinity if no schedule is public). D_want(school) = days from t until the school's stated or historical-median hire date (from cbb.coach_vacancy_search_state). Feature = P(D_free(c) <= D_want) computed from the two pmfs assuming independence; every date and buyout figure is stamped with first public report time and excluded if reported after t.

cbb.conf_strength.market_note: Only the final 'compare to market-implied conference strength' step is market-derived; the hierarchical conference random-effect model uses game results alone, so a market-free rebuild is the model without that comparison.
cbb.conf_strength.measurement_fix: Fit a hierarchical margin model on all D1 games before as-of t: margin_ij = r_i - r_j + h*home_ij + e, with r_i = c_conf(i) + u_i, c ~ N(0, tau_c^2), u ~ N(0, tau_u^2), variance components estimated by REML on the last 3 seasons and ratings shrunk toward a preseason prior; conference strength = posterior mean and sd of c_conf plus mean team u of that conference's games; uncertainty scales with 1/sqrt(non-conference games played). Game weight exp(-days/60). Uses no price, line or market rating; the market comparison is a separate benchmark.
